## Analyst piece flags Taiwan Semiconductor as potentially ~13% overvalued on Maia 300 AI chip demand focus

Valuation caution on TSM centered on hyperscaler custom silicon demand (Maia 300) is relevant for the foundry thesis — if custom-chip volumes are already priced in at a premium, the margin of safety on TSM narrows even as the structural story remains intact.

- Simply Wall St. analysis argues TSM could be approximately 13% overvalued at current levels — figure stated in the headline.
- The overvaluation case is tied to the Maia 300 AI chip as the key demand driver priced in.
- Medium-confidence signal; single-outlet valuation analysis, not a consensus broker view.
- Touches foundry capacity and silicon architecture competition themes.
